bug_report:
[12 Regression] ICE on template with -Wformat-security (error reporting routines re-entered.)
When compiling this minimal example with gcc 12.2, 12.4, 14.2.1 or trunk (or really any version I tried on Godbolt) I get an ICE (tried on x86_64 and arm64).

--- ice.cc ---

__attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)))
int fails(const char *, ...) { return 0; }

int works(const char *, ...) { return 0; }

template<auto func, typename...  Args>
auto wrap(Args... args) -> decltype(func(args...))
{
  return func(args...);
}


int main() {
    wrap<fails>("Test!");
}

---

I minimized the code as far as possible to not include any headers.
Compile with: `g++ ice.cc -Wformat-security -Wformat`

Replacing the template instantiation with the works instead of the fails function does not produce an ICE. Using -Wno-format-security will also not produce the ICE.
